rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name and ZIP. The agent located the helmet order and executed an exchange to the requested variant, but did so without explicitly restating the change and obtaining the user’s confirmation immediately before the write, which the policy requires. For the luggage request, the agent asserted an unsupported rule (“only one exchange per delivered order”) and assumed the luggage was in the same order as the helmet without verifying the order details, then refused a likely-permitted exchange. This is a fabricated restriction and a failure to use tools to validate eligibility. The agent then processed a return after stating details but again did not explicitly solicit confirmation of those exact details before submitting. The grill modification was handled correctly with explicit confirmation and proper tool use. Overall, due to the unsupported refusal and missing pre-write confirmation for at least one action, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
